name: Emel
desc:
Emel is an Adret NPC who is a member of [the Ministry](faction:the_ministry). They can be found leaning on a small islet located on the outskirts of the port of [Summer Isle](location:summer_isle).

They will give you a mission to kill an enemy in the [Songseeker Wilds](location:songseeker_wilds); you must grip a player in the Songseeker Wilds and return to them to obtain reputation and rewards. If you complete it you will gain reputation with the Ministry and a payment for your deeds.
additional_info:
-   Emel's racial variant appears to be Boulder.
-   Due to the similarity in name and Aspect variant, Emel may be a sibling of [Imel](entity:emel).
